what.title: What is Younit?
what.body1: Younit opens EFG Hermes' trading infrastructure through APIs, providing access to Egypt's stock market, real-time and historical market data, and an open-source Python SDK.
what.body2: As the first retail algorithmic trading API in Egypt and the wider MENA region, Younit enables users to automate trades, build trading apps, test strategies, backtest ideas, and work with real market data through one platform.
what.videoAlt: A short film: a single square becomes a rule, the rule sends signals down three paths, and a grid lights up as the strategy runs on its own.

how.title: How Younit Works

steps.title: Create your account
steps.body: Sign up for Younit by downloading the EFG Hermes ONE app. Once you have downloaded the app, click "Get your API key" on the Younit website and enter your username and ID to generate your API key.

steps.title: Connect to Younit
steps.body: Install the Python SDK on your computer. This lets you connect to the Egyptian stock market and use Younit through code.

steps.title: Access market data
steps.body: Use the API to access live prices, historical market data, market depth, and your portfolio. You can use this information to understand the market and build your own tools.

steps.title: Build your strategy
steps.body: Write your own trading rules or use a model to decide when to buy or sell. Your strategy could be as simple or advanced as you want.

steps.title: Test before you trade
steps.body: Use historical market data to backtest your strategy. This shows you how your idea would have performed in the past and helps you identify what works and what does not before putting real money at risk.

steps.title: Trade automatically
steps.body: Once you are ready, connect your strategy to your Younit account. Your code can then place and manage trades automatically based on the rules you created.

steps.title: Keep building
steps.body: Younit is not just for trading. You can use the infrastructure to build trading apps, analytics tools, portfolio dashboards, and other financial products.

how.closing: In simple terms: Younit gives you the tools to access the market, build an idea, test it with real data, and turn it into a working trading solution.

who.efgBody: EFG Hermes, an EFG Holding company (HRHO.CA), is the leading investment bank in the Middle East and North Africa. As the financial partner of choice in MENA, it combines deep regional insight with global expertise to serve individuals, corporations, institutions, and governments. The firm offers a comprehensive suite of financial services across Sell-Side and Buy-Side activities, including Investment Banking, Brokerage, Research, Asset Management, and Private Equity. With a focused distribution network, rigorous sector coverage, and a track record of execution, EFG Hermes delivers tailored solutions to meet clients' needs.
